svg.title: Subject / נושא
svg.desc: Chapter 3, Hebrew p21, English p22; also Chapter 11 distinction 21, Hebrew p233, English p234. The subject is that of which something is affirmed or denied, or the bearer sought for a given attribute. Following the user’s paired-role revision, the statement tile’s back subject cell is enlarged and emphasized, with its circle term glyph. The smaller front predicate cell and square are partially transparent. The arrow still points from subject toward predicate; it is not reversed. Emphasis identifies the subject, not amount, scope, truth, certainty, or temporal priority. The arrow is the inherited predicate carrier, not an inference or causal process. This replaces the former baseline-and-shapes Subject drawing while preserving its key.
